authorization: Manuscript preparation only. No inference, pilot, job submission or automatic launch. Exact request preflight, an approved spending cap and a separate launch instruction are required.
model_policy: Use exactly the four specified model IDs. No automatic model, provider or service-tier substitutions. Public metadata is not account-level admission. Freeze the literal requests and verified total-billable-output ceilings before launch.

flowsom.binding_status: frozen_local_bundle; requires exact admission before launch

leiden.identity: unchanged frozen main B004 Leiden assignments

pixie_tiff.identity: unchanged frozen main B004 PIXIE assignments

evidence.source: Deposited processed 45-marker H5AD X plus CD123 and CDX2 observation measurements, in the frozen 47-marker order. Do not substitute the RobustScaler SOM feature matrix.
evidence.means: Within-cluster mean of arcsinh(processed expression/5), standardized with marker center and population SD (ddof=0) fitted using only cells in the four existing B004 training regions. Scale 1 only for an exactly constant marker.
evidence.fractions: Within-cluster fraction of deposited processed marker values strictly greater than zero, computed before transformation/standardization; not validated biological positivity.
evidence.encoding: Compute full-precision float64 statistics, then use numpy.rint to encode integer thousandths. Divide by 1000. Reuse identical mean integers within pairs.
evidence.controls: Same cell memberships, marker order, cluster order, prompt, ontology, batch boundaries, model/provider, decoding settings and parser within pairs. Only the fractions matrix is added.
evidence.preprocessing_selection: No new outcome-driven marker, model, cluster, repeat or checkpoint selection.

primary_population: The two existing B004 test regions; query every occupied cluster in each full-cohort partition. Preserve all reference-Noise cells.
primary_endpoint: Equal-weighted mean of the two test-region cell-level reference-agreement values, retaining missing/invalid assignments as errors in each full planned denominator.
contrast: all_means_fractions minus all_means, paired by method, model, repeat, batch, cluster and region.

metrics: fixed-28-label macro-F1 with absent classes scored zero
reporting.repeats: Retain all three requested repetitions. Report mean and sample SD. A failed generated response is never replaced by a favorable resample.
reporting.consistency: Modal valid-label count divided by all three requested repetitions. Missing labels contribute no vote. No valid votes means abstention. Ties follow frozen ontology order. Noise is a cell-type output, not abstention.
reporting.noise_sensitivity: Secondary exclusion removes only reference-Noise cells from scoring; do not filter them before fitting or summaries. Keep predicted Noise errors on retained cells.
reporting.interpretation: Previously examined B004 data, one donor, transductive frozen clusters/profiles. Repetitions measure computational variation; no donor-generalization or calibrated-probability claim.
reporting.macro_f1: Calculate fixed-28-label macro-F1 within each test region, absent classes scored zero. Average the two regions equally per repetition, then report mean and sample SD across the three repetitions.

run_order: Three repeat blocks. Deterministically counterbalance paired arm submission order using SHA256(protocol_id|repeat|method|model|batch). Batch execution order is provider-controlled and is not claimed to be guaranteed.

sharing.7: The fractions arm supplies the updated full-marker benchmark.
sharing.9: Use fresh repeated predictions from the two marker-only arms for consistency. Historical reference-assisted repeatability remains separate.
sharing.14: Use matched arm pairs to estimate the fractions contrast.
sharing.accounting: One physical call record and charge per unique request; reuse predictions only for analyses declared here. Never alias independent repetitions or biological conditions.

response_policy.format: JSON object with exactly a: [{i: anonymous integer query ID, l: integer label code 0..27}]. The label dictionary is the frozen original28 order.
response_policy.validation: Strict atomic whole-batch acceptance. Reject duplicate JSON keys,extra fields,extra/missing/duplicate IDs,wrong types,numeric strings,out-of-range label codes,nonterminal/refused/truncated output. All cases in a rejected batch remain missing.
response_policy.retry_scope: Only definitely pre-generation transport failures; never regenerate invalid annotation/format output. Ambiguous outcomes retain cost reservation and require reconciliation.

required_before_launch: Admit all raw measurement and completed frozen clustering hashes
Build and independently verify exact47-marker evidence and paired payloads
Pass strict evidence,parser,Batch-envelope and request-identity tests
Verify exact provider/high-reasoning/total-billable-output contracts and price reservations
Seal all384 literal request bodies and their hashes
Obtain an approved spending cap and separate explicit launch instruction

measurement_source.authoritative: processed H5AD float64 X plus CD123/CDX2 obs

display_conventions.within_model: Three-repeat modal valid label, ties in ontology order, no valid vote means no displayed prediction.
display_conventions.across_models: One within-model modal vote per model. Cross-model ties use the specified OpenAI,Anthropic,Google,DeepSeek family order. Display summaries are distinct from primary per-repetition metrics.
display_conventions.figure4_case: Leiden-Fable illustrative pipeline prespecified before annotation results, not selected by agreement.
display_conventions.figure4_cluster_examples: Three largest occupied Leiden clusters by cell count, ties by cluster ID.
display_conventions.spatial_examples: Use the same fixed tissue-region view as Figure 2C. No low/high-agreement window selection.
